_about: Shared geometry/colour contract for the Settings hub, Profile & Preferences, and Memory Management mocks (docs/reference/settings/*.png, 1024x1536 canvases, phone screen x186-836 y18-1492 -> 650x1474 crop, 1.654 px/pt at 393pt). Horizontal ratios are device-true; vertical ones are NOT (crop aspect 0.441 vs device 0.4613) and are re-derived from renders.

card._what: One probe per screen: interior sample vs the page BESIDE the card at the same y (ground differs down the page, so an absolute fill is not a contract). The rim row is the +6 L minimum.

cta._what: Saturation (R-B) of the hub's Upgrade pill: the mock reads ~110 at #FEB58D; a glass pill reads <=20.
